mechanism: Fuse RMSNorm forward into one row-wise reduction kernel and implement analytic backward as one row-wise input-gradient kernel plus one column-wise weight-gradient reduction kernel.
expected_effect: Reduce launch count and intermediate global-memory traffic while preserving FP32 reduction semantics.
risk: Triton compiler or sm70 support failure
resource_tradeoff: Stores one fp32 inverse-RMS value per row for backward; no full-size workspace.
ablation_plan: quick L0 subset before official L0
